newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya opposition politician returns to Mombasa.
newsitem.headline: Kenya opposition politician returns to Mombasa.

text.p: Kenyan Moslem preacher Sheikh Balala, a fierce critic of President Daniel arap Moi, returned to his home city of Mombasa on Monday two years after being forced into exile, witnesses said.
A crowd of 1,000 chanting "Moi must go" greeted Balala who arrived at Mombasa's Moi International Airport at 6 p.m. local time (1500 GMT), witnesses said.
Balala was met by opposition FORD-Asili MP Rashid Mzee before being driven to the Sakina Mosque for prayers.
Balala returned to Kenya on Saturday vowing to spearhead a campaign for constitutional reforms. He was forced into exile in Germany when Moi's government accused him of being Yememi.
Balala plans a pro-reform rally on Tuesday, aides said.
Nine people were killed in Kenya last Monday in the worst civil unrest since a 1990 campaign for multi-party democracy. In the last week students in Nairobi have repeatedly clashed with police.
